study type: Descriptive, retrospective series of case studies
cohort: Patients who underwent elective or emergency cesarean section at a public teaching hospital in Lima, Peru.
finding: The cesarean section rate at the studied hospital exceeded the WHO recommendation, with previous cesarean delivery and cephalopelvic disproportion being the most common indications.
mod_finding: The study focuses on cesarean delivery rates and indications and does not provide specific findings related to mode of birth beyond the high overall cesarean section rate.
